chemistry-killer-11.material:
Kwi-$\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) ightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$, i-equilibrium constant ngokuxinana yi-$K = 0.4$ (iiyunithi zishiyiwe) kubushushu obuthile. Kolu bushushu, i-$\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ ne-$\mathrm{NO_2}$ zibekwa kwizikhongozeli ezintathu zishiywe ixesha elide.

chemistry-killer-11.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukuxinana. (A) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (B) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (C) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
